subject: music
title: Beat & Pulse
welcome_lead: The steady heartbeat under every piece of music.
meta_desc: KS3 tempo: beat, pulse, strong and weak beats.
final_note: The pulse is what makes you tap your foot.

concepts.def: Accent on a weak beat — off-beat.
Device that ticks a steady beat.

walkthroughs.body_html: The beat is the steady pulse you tap or nod to. In 4/4 time, beat 1 is strongest, then 3, then 2 and 4 are weakest.
A metronome ticks at a chosen BPM. Practising with one keeps tempo steady. Set 60 BPM and that's one tick per second — like a clock.
Syncopation means putting accents on weak beats. This makes music groove — funk, reggae and ska all rely on syncopation.
